LanguageData.Gun_PK_RWP.label: PK
LanguageData.Gun_PK_RWP.description: The PK is a powerful Soviet-era machine gun known for its high rate of fire and rugged reliability. It is chambered for 7.62×54mm rounds, making it effective at delivering sustained automatic fire over long distances. Ideal for suppressing enemies and providing heavy support in a firefight, it serves as a formidable addition to any combat outpost. However, its weight and recoil require a strong operator to wield effectively.
